# JioMed Family Care

> Physician-owned family medicine clinic in Leawood, KS. Where life and health unite — same-day acute care, wellness exams, chronic disease management, in-office procedures, diagnostics, weight management, concierge medicine, and aesthetic medicine.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 11213 Nall Ave Ste 100, Leawood, KS 66211, United States
- Phone: (913) 291-0135
- Email: info@jiomedfamilycare.com
- Website: https://jiomedfamilycare.com

## Hours

- Saturday: Closed
- Sunday: Closed

## Services
- [Acute Care Appointments](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/acute-care-appointments): Same-day sick visits
- [Wellness Exams](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/wellness-exams): Annual physicals and preventive care
- [Chronic Disease Management](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/chronic-disease-management): Ongoing care for chronic conditions
- [In-Office Procedures](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/procedures): Dermatology, gyn, and other procedures
- [Diagnostic & Testing](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/diagnostic-testing-services): On-site testing during visits
- [Weight Management](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/weight-management): Medical weight management with Enara Health
- [Concierge Medicine](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/concierge-medicine): Membership-based primary care
- [Aesthetic Medicine](https://jiomedfamilycare.com/aesthetic-medicine): Aesthetic treatments
